about: Jattashankar Industries Ltd is a standalone agro-commodity trading company. After selling its legacy Silvassa yarn plant and machinery in FY25, the company underwent a promoter and control change in Aug,25 and expanded its objects into agricultural products, edible oils, food products and allied commodities. Its current marketed range includes pulses, wheat, maize, castor seeds and castor oil. [1] [2] [3]
